description: Franchise untangler. Walks the related-works graph from a media ID across multiple hops — sequels, prequels, side stories, movies, OVAs, source/adaptation — and returns them ordered by a relation-priority/year heuristic, not a topological franchise chronology. Use anime_get_media first to confirm the ID.

id.description: AniList media ID of any entry in the franchise.

max_depth.description: Maximum hops to traverse from the root entry. Default 2. Maximum 4. Deeper traversal makes more AniList requests — use 3–4 only for large franchises.

name: anime_get_relations

entries.description: All franchise entries in suggested watch/read order. Main entries first, then supplementary. Within each group, ordered by relation type priority then season year.

items.description: A franchise entry in watch/read order.

depth.description: Hop count along the first shortest BFS discovery path.

format.description: Format: TV, MOVIE, OVA, ONA, MANGA, NOVEL, etc.

is_root.description: True for the traversal root entry.

parent_id.description: Discovery parent ID; null for the root.

path.description: Root-to-entry IDs along the first shortest BFS path.

relation_to_parent.description: Discovery parent edge relation; null for the root.

relation_to_root.description: Direct root-edge relation only; null for the root and deeper entries.

season.description: Broadcast season label, e.g. "FALL 2023", or null.

season_year.description: Year of the season, or null.

watch_order_category.description: "main" for canonical story (prequels, source, sequels). "supplementary" for side stories, OVAs, specials, and spin-offs.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: Root media ID not found on AniList. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

root_id.description: The AniList ID used as the traversal root.

totalCount.description: Total unique franchise entries found — the response is complete, not paged.

total_entries.description: Total unique entries found across the franchise.

title: Anime Get Relations
